title: Command & Conquer
overview:
More than one million sold worldwide!

Welcome to the New World Order

In this gritty high-tech world, guerrilla strategies, savage combat and merciless destruction are the norm. Choose a side and then prepare for combat on a global scale. Will you rule? Or be ruled?

- Hyper-real combat experience with fast-paced game play of up to 60 frames per second.
- Dozens of units including stealth tanks, ion cannons and flamethrower infantry.
- Adrenaline-pumping soundtrack in Red Book audio for incredible stereo sound.

Packed with intense action video and 3-D rendered excitement!

With more than 1 million units sold worldwide, Command & Conquer is one of the most popular games of all time!
